channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: What Are We Wearing In 2026?
item.description: Sneakers are no longer the hottest thing in footwear. At least not in the way they have been. With GOAT, we look at the present, past and future of the category

item.title: Meet The Jordan Brand Collaborators Pushing Fashion Forward
item.description: Jordan Brand, Highsnobiety and Zalando have collaborated on a concept capsule collection designed by four up-and-coming European designers: Lou de Bartoly, Richard Ntege, James Harjette and Kasia Kucharska

item.title: These High-Tech Jackets Were Dyed With Century-Old Mud
item.description: Japanese menswear label KUON has gotten old C.P. Company stock and taken it to the tiny subtropical Amami Oshima island. There, it gets dyed in muddy fields.

item.title: Birkenstock Made A Shoe For All Seasons
item.description: For SS26, Birkenstock brings the new HIGHWOOD MOC LACE LOW, a closed silhouette that carries the same ideological core and the signature Birkenstock Footbed.

item.title: Lykke Li Sees God
item.description: And death. And works through it all on her sixth studio album, The Afterparty.

item.title: Kiko Kostadinov’s Tabi-Toed ASICS Are a Surprise Deep Cut
item.description: ASICS and Kiko Kostadinov aren't merely jumping on the Tabi trend; the Japanese label was making tabi shoes before Martin Margiela was even born.

item.title: Starbucks Wakes Up Fashion Week with LP Giobbi
item.description: It’s that time of year again when the pace of fashion week is relentless. Call times begin at dawn. Garment bags sweep through the city, and steam rises backstage as stylists make last-minute adjustments. Across Manhattan, from Tribeca to Midtown, one constant keeps the week moving: caffeine.

item.title: Why Aren't More People Talking About the Hermès Boombox?
item.description: Hermès' Fall/Winter 2026 leather boombox bag deserves more attention than it got on the runway. This masterpiece needs to be studied.

item.title: Skate-Coded Birkenstock Hiking Shoes? Louis Vuitton's Footwear Designer Did That
item.description: Thibo Denis’ Birkenstock 1774 sneakers combine a bizarre mix of references: 2000s skate shoes, hiking boots, and double-strapped sandals.

item.title: New Balance’s Blacked-Out Dad Shoe Is the Father of All Retro Sneakers
item.description: New Balance's super inky U2010 dad shoe is a wearable ode to the true power of a monochromatic moment.
